env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local
mkdir $WORK/bin

cd a/main
! logos build ./...
stderr 'ERROR \[capabilities::unauthorized_unsafe\]: Transitive dependency ''example\.com/dep'' imports ''unsafe'''
stderr 'example\.com/main/cmd'
stderr '-> example\.com/dep'
stderr '-> unsafe'
stderr 'transitive_unsafe_allowlist'
cd ../..

cd b/main
logos build -o $WORK/bin/b$GOEXE ./cmd
exec $WORK/bin/b$GOEXE
stdout '^42$'
cd ../..

cd c/main
! logos build ./...
stderr 'ERROR \[capabilities::unauthorized_unsafe\]: Transitive dependency ''example\.com/cdep'' imports ''unsafe'''
stderr '-> unsafe'
cd ../..

cd c/main
go build -o $WORK/bin/d$GOEXE ./cmd
cd ../..

cd e/main
logos build -o $WORK/bin/e$GOEXE ./cmd
stderr '\[capabilities::unauthorized_unsafe\].*example\.com/edep'
cd ../..

cd f/main
! logos build ./...
stderr 'ERROR \[capabilities::unauthorized_unsafe\]: Transitive dependency ''example\.com/fdep'' imports ''unsafe'''
cd ../..

cd g/main
logos build -o $WORK/bin/g$GOEXE ./cmd
! stderr '\[capabilities::unauthorized_unsafe\]'

cd ../..
cd h/main
! logos build ./...
stderr 'ERROR \[capabilities::unauthorized_unsafe\]: Transitive dependency ''example\.com/hshort'' imports ''unsafe'''
stderr '-> example\.com/hshort'
stderr '-> unsafe'
! stderr 'hlong'
! stderr 'hmid'
cd ../..

-- a/main/go.mod --
module example.com/main

go 1.27

require example.com/dep v0.0.0

replace example.com/dep => ../dep

-- a/main/logos.toml --
[capabilities]
transitive_unsafe = "deny"

-- a/main/cmd/main.lgo --
package main

import (
	"fmt"

	"example.com/dep"
)

func main() { fmt.Println(dep.Msg()) }

-- a/dep/go.mod --
module example.com/dep

go 1.27

-- a/dep/dep.go --
package dep

import (
	"strconv"
	"unsafe"
)

func Msg() string {
	var x = 42
	return strconv.Itoa(*(*int)(unsafe.Pointer(&x)))
}

-- b/main/go.mod --
module example.com/main

go 1.27

require example.com/dep v0.0.0

replace example.com/dep => ../dep

-- b/main/logos.toml --
[capabilities]
transitive_unsafe = "deny"
transitive_unsafe_allowlist = ["example.com/dep/**"]

-- b/main/cmd/main.lgo --
package main

import (
	"fmt"

	"example.com/dep"
)

func main() { fmt.Println(dep.Msg()) }

-- h/main/go.mod --
module example.com/hmain

go 1.27

require (
	example.com/hshort v0.0.0
	example.com/hlong v0.0.0
	example.com/hmid v0.0.0
)

replace example.com/hshort => ../short

replace example.com/hlong => ../long

replace example.com/hmid => ../mid

-- h/main/logos.toml --
[capabilities]
transitive_unsafe = "deny"

-- h/main/cmd/main.go --
package main

import (
	_ "example.com/hlong"
	_ "example.com/hshort"
)

func main() {}

-- h/short/go.mod --
module example.com/hshort

go 1.27

-- h/short/short.go --
package hshort

import "unsafe"

var _ = unsafe.Sizeof(0)

-- h/long/go.mod --
module example.com/hlong

go 1.27

require (
	example.com/hmid v0.0.0
)

replace example.com/hmid => ../mid

-- h/long/long.go --
package hlong

import _ "example.com/hmid"

-- h/mid/go.mod --
module example.com/hmid

go 1.27

require example.com/hshort v0.0.0

replace example.com/hshort => ../short

-- h/mid/mid.go --
package hmid

import _ "example.com/hshort"
